why_this_matters: Most trauma center activation criteria, including local hospital cards, are built on the national field triage guideline. It sorts injured patients into two groups: RED (high risk for serious injury, highest-level trauma center) and YELLOW (moderate risk, trauma center as available within the regional system). ACS asks that the criteria not be altered, so Kairos links to the official version.

link.label: Open ACS field triage guideline
link.offline_text: The guideline is hosted by the American College of Surgeons and needs an internet connection.

clinical_takeaway: Use the national guideline for destination decisions in the field; use your hospital's own activation criteria (Local Protocols) for who responds and how fast once the patient arrives.
attribution: National Guideline for the Field Triage of Injured Patients © American College of Surgeons. Kairos links to it and does not reproduce its criteria.
